experiment: Single-factor inclusive bbox filter after H3 border gathering
unchanged_preparation: Original prepare_method for both H3 variants; each whole trial prepares afresh
new_query: Same H3 gather and internal acceptance; after gathering x,y for border rows, inclusive bbox mask compacts row indices and both coordinate arrays, then same exact predicate
bbox_predicate: x>=xmin and x<=xmax and y>=ymin and y<=ymax
main_measurement: Single outer wall timer: fresh preparation plus 1000 consecutive query calls, every call allocates its result normally; no final result cache
main_instrumentation: New bbox variant uses same core timing boundaries and normal metrics as original; extra bbox phase clocks enabled only in separate profiling trials
profiling: All seven methods randomly interleaved in same profiling round; original uses original exact clocks; bbox variant separately records mask+three-array compaction, exact predicate, gather and assembly; profile ranking is not substituted for main end-to-end ranking
correctness: Full ID-set, false-positive/negative, duplicate, edge-probe and coverage checks before benchmark; post-batch and post-profile ID checks outside timers
warmup: One fresh preparation+query per method/dataset before whole trials; profile states prepared outside timing then three query warmups
gc: Uniformly disabled during trials, restored afterwards
